===Verb===
{{ru-verb|крыть|impf|pf=покры́ть}}

# to [[cover]], to [[roof]] (a house); to [[thatch]], to [[tile]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''крыть''' [[шифер|ши́фером]]|t=to [[slate]]}}

# {{lb|ru|card games}} to [[cover]], to [[trump]]
#: {{ux|ru|ему́ не́чем '''крыть'''|q=colloquial|t=he hasn't a leg to stand on, there's nothing he can say to that|lit=he has no (good) card to cover}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[scold]], to [[rail]] {{q|at}}, to [[swear]] {{q|at}}
# {{lb|ru|agriculture}} to [[mount]] (an animal to mate)
